<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Continue moving red diamond: UP x5, LEFT x2
actions = ['UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'LEFT', 'LEFT']
result = action(actions)

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        b = n['boundary']
        print(f"Player at ({b[0][0]}, {b[0][1]})")

# Find red diamond center (exclude 1-pixel dots)
red_outline = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] > 1]
if not red_outline:
    # Try finding from boundary of multi-pixel red objects
    all_red_outline = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] == 1:
            continue
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_red_outline.append(p)
    if all_red_outline:
        rows = [p[0] for p in all_red_outline]
        cols = [p[1] for p in all_red_outline]
        print(f"Red diamond center (outline): ({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

containers = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Containers remaining: {len(containers)}")
for c in containers:
    b = c['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  at ({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

print(f"Score: {last_action_result.get('score')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
